meta.title: Dhamani
meta.description: Dhamani connects families who need blood with nearby eligible donors.

home.title: Dhamani
home.intro: Dhamani connects families who need blood with nearby eligible donors.
home.donorHint: Donors join and reply on WhatsApp only. The button opens WhatsApp with JOIN ready to send.
home.how1: Post a request with the hospital and blood group.
home.how2: We alert eligible donors near the hospital on WhatsApp, a few at a time.
home.how3: You see who is coming on one live page.
home.howPrivacy: Donor phone numbers are never shown.

login.title: Sign in with WhatsApp
login.body: No password and no SMS. You send us a short code from your own WhatsApp.
login.step1: Tap the button. WhatsApp opens with the message ready.
login.step2: Send the message without changing it.
login.step3: Come back here. This page signs you in by itself.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in 10 minutes.
login.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

form.title: Request blood
form.hospitalHint: Type at least 2 letters of the name or city.
form.nearMeError: We could not get your location. Type the hospital name instead.
form.noResults: No centres found. Try another spelling.
form.neededByError: Choose a time later than now.
form.critical: The doctor says this cannot wait
form.criticalHint: Mark this only for an emergency.
form.slip: Photo of the doctor's request slip (optional)
form.slipHint: It helps us verify your request and alert more donors. Only coordinators can see it.
form.slipTooBig: Choose a photo smaller than 3 MB.
form.stockBody: You can also see this centre's available stock on e-RaktKosh.
form.tooManyOpen: You already have 2 open requests. Close one before posting another.
form.needsApheresis: This centre cannot collect SDP platelets. Choose a centre that has apheresis.
form.generic: We could not post your request. Check the form and try again.

live.alerted: We have alerted {count, plural, one {# donor} other {# donors}} near the hospital. You will see replies here.
live.reported: Thank you. A coordinator will look at it.
live.heldBody: A coordinator will check it before donors are alerted. This happens when a request mentions money. Donating blood is free.
live.frozenBody: A coordinator is checking it. No new donors are being alerted.
live.closedFulfilled: This request is fulfilled. Thank you to everyone who helped.
live.slipVerified: Slip checked. More donors can now be alerted.
live.slipReview: Slip received. A coordinator will check it.
live.actionFailed: That did not work. Please try again.

common.chooseGroupFirst: Choose a blood group to continue.

bloodGroup.label: Blood group
bloodGroup.unknownBody: The lab that took the sample can tell you the blood group. You can post the request once you know it.

rights.title: Your right
rights.body: A blood bank cannot refuse to issue blood only because you have no replacement donor.

requestForm.patientHint: First name and initial only, for example Priya K.
requestForm.patientError: Enter the first name and initial.

login.title: Coordinator sign in
login.body: For Dhamani coordinators only. Accounts are created by a super admin.
login.invalid: That email and password do not match. Check them and try again.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.

tabHint.held: Requests that mention money. Release them only after checking with the family.
tabHint.slip: Slips the phone could not read. Compare the photo with the request.
tabHint.escalated: Wave 3 went out and the request is still short of donors. Call the blood centre.
tabHint.reported: Requests people reported, and requests frozen after 2 reports.

detail.slipAlt: Photo of the hospital slip for request {code}
detail.waveTitle: Wave {wave}: {count, plural, one {# donor} other {# donors}}
detail.noPhones: Phone numbers are never shown here.

actions.confirmCancel: Cancel this request? Confirmed donors will be told it is closed.
actions.confirmFreeze: Freeze this request? No new donors will be alerted until it is unfrozen.
actions.none: No actions are possible for a closed request.
actions.failed: That action is not possible for this request now. Refresh the page to see its current state.

messages.title: Message log
messages.filterHint: For example DH-AB12. Leave it empty to see the latest messages.

sim.title: Simulation
sim.off: Simulation is off. Set SIMULATION_MODE=true to use this panel.
sim.reseedBody: Replace the 50 simulated donors with a new set. Real donors are not touched.
sim.repliesBody: Simulated donors alerted for this request reply with this mix. The rest stay silent. Real phones are not affected.
sim.invalid: Enter a code like DH-AB12 and two percentages that add up to 100 or less.
sim.notFound: No request has that code. Check it and try again.
sim.resetBody: Delete every request at a DEV ONLY hospital, with its alerts and messages. Requests at real hospitals stay. The activity log is kept.
sim.resetDone: {count, plural, one {# demo request} other {# demo requests}} deleted.

admin.title: Admin
admin.failed24h: Failed sends in the last 24 hours
admin.name: Name
admin.newPassword: Password for {email}: {password}. Copy it now and share it privately. It is shown only once.

errors.invalid: Enter a name of at least 2 letters and a valid email.
errors.exists: An account with that email already exists.
errors.self: You cannot disable your own account or change your own role.
errors.not_found: That account no longer exists. Refresh the page.

admin.noDonorList: There is no list of donors here, on purpose. Donors appear only on the requests they were alerted for, and phone numbers are never shown.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.body: Donors who brought new donors, by city. Only people who went on to donate (confirmed by donor and family) count. Use this to choose whom to thank publicly, for example on 1 October, National Voluntary Blood Donation Day.
referrals.rule: Recognition only: certificates, mementos or a public thank-you. No cash, vouchers or gifts of value: that would break the rule that blood donation is unpaid.
referrals.empty: No referred donor has donated yet.

consent.no: Does not want to be named

referrals.failed: Could not send the question. Refresh and try again.

me.title: Your donor page
me.private: This page is only for you. Do not share the link. It works for 24 hours.
me.expired: This link has expired or is not valid. Send STATUS to Dhamani on WhatsApp to get a new one.
me.name: Name
me.nextNow: Now. The blood centre does the final health check.
me.badgeNone: Your first verified donation earns the Lifegiver badge.
me.badgeNext: {left, plural, one {# more verified donation} other {# more verified donations}} to Lifegiver {next}.
me.noCertificates: A certificate appears here when a donation is confirmed by you and by the family.
me.needsName: To print certificates we need your name in English letters. Reply to our WhatsApp question, or send STATUS to see it again.
me.inviteBody: Share your link with friends and family. It opens WhatsApp with their sign-up ready.
me.inviteStats: {joined} joined with your link. {donated} of them have donated.
me.inviteShare: I am a blood donor with Dhamani. When someone near you needs blood, it alerts you on WhatsApp. Join here: {link}
me.inviteNote: Dhamani thanks people who bring donors with recognition only. There are no prizes or payments.
